assessment.evaluationReason: Calculated from completed Alpaca OHLCV bars using the existing V2SignalEngine. This is decision support, not an order instruction.

decision.reason: Partial alignment; wait for confirmation. 5M > VWAP, 5M 9 EMA > 20 EMA, 5M 20 EMA > 50 SMA.

methodology.indicatorHistory: EMA9/EMA20, SMA50, RSI14, MACD(12,26,9), ATR14 and session VWAP are calculated from provider OHLCV.
methodology.extension: 1m absolute close-to-session-VWAP distance divided by the simple 14-bar average of True Range; intended to match the installed Thinkorswim 1M formula. Session VWAP parity must be confirmed on matched bars.
methodology.relativeVolume: 5m current volume divided by average volume for the same regular-session 5m clock slot across prior sessions; minimum five prior samples. This is not a vendor-supplied consolidated RVOL field.
methodology.freshness: Age is measured from the expected bar close (bar timestamp + timeframe), not the bar-open timestamp.
limitations: 1m/5m decision bars are sourced through historical REST; the optional WebSocket is not currently subscribed or lacks a fresh 50-bar 1m history.
Provider feed and entitlement determine coverage.
No catalyst, halt, spread, order-book, or Thinkorswim study data is inferred.
A true signal remains unavailable when history, freshness, or same-slot volume baseline is insufficient.
